answer: Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 2 epochs later. Because the karst domain is checked at the dawn verifier, the jade audit reveals the rejected digest, and a replayed signature burns the operator its bond. That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Slashing removes 40 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
